title: perityle discoidea
intro: Perityle discoidea, commonly known as the Desert Marigold or Foothill Marigold, is a shrubby perennial plant native to the southwestern United States and northwestern Mexico. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Perityle discoidea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antimicrobial and antiviral activities. Additionally, studies suggest that Perityle discoidea may have therapeutic actions, including wound healing, and could be used to treat various health conditions.
